# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-config-doc.py from roles/*/meta/argument_specs.yml
     and roles/*/defaults/main.yml. Do not edit by hand. -->

All settings go in your host file (`inventory/host_vars/<host>.yml`), see
[config.example.yml](../config.example.yml). They are validated when the
playbook starts: wrong types, unknown sub-keys and invalid choices are
refused, and unknown `devbox_*` names are reported (typos).

## Rollout

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_mode` | str (observe \| enforce) | `observe` | observe: nothing is blocked, everything that would be is logged (iron-proxy audit "warn", kernel log "agent-egress:"). enforce: default-deny for real. Start with observe. |

## Zones

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_admin_user` | str | **required** | Your existing admin login on the server. It is never modified, except for joining devbox_share_group. It must already have an SSH key in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys when devbox_harden_sshd is on. |
| `devbox_agent_user` | str | `agent` | The confined user that runs the agents. Created if missing. If it already exists, its supplementary groups are reset to devbox_share_group only and its password is locked. |
| `devbox_agent_ssh_keys` | list of str | `[]` | Public keys allowed to log in as the agent (your laptop, T3 Code desktop/mobile...). The list is exclusive: keys not listed are removed, an empty list removes them all. |
| `devbox_share_group` | str | `devshare` | Group shared by the admin and the agent for the workspaces. |
| `devbox_workspace_root` | path | `/srv/work` | Shared workspace directory (group devbox_share_group, setgid). |
| `devbox_proxy_user` | str | `iron-proxy` | System user running iron-proxy and owning the real secrets. |
| `devbox_harden_sshd` | bool | `true` | Disable SSH password and root login for every user. Refused if the admin has no authorized key, so you cannot lock yourself out. |

## Secrets swapped by iron-proxy

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_builtin_secrets` | list of str (claude_oauth \| github_pat) | `[claude_oauth, github_pat]` | Built-in swapped secrets. claude_oauth: Claude subscription token (claude setup-token), placeholder in CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. github_pat: GitHub token for git over HTTPS and gh, placeholder in GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN. Store values with sudo iron-proxy-set-secret. |
| `devbox_secrets` | list of dict | `[]` | Additional secrets swapped by iron-proxy (API keys of services your code calls).<br>Fields:<br>• `name` (str, required): File name under /etc/iron-proxy/secrets ([a-z0-9_]).<br>• `proxy_value` (str, required): Placeholder the agent sends (put it in the project's .env). At least 8 characters.<br>• `hosts` (list of str, required): Hosts (globs allowed) for which the placeholder is replaced.<br>• `match_headers` (list of str): Headers to scan (e.g. Authorization, X-Api-Key).<br>• `match_path` (bool): Also replace the placeholder in the URL path.<br>• `match_query` (bool): Also replace the placeholder in the query string.<br>• `match_body` (bool): Also replace the placeholder in request bodies.<br>• `allow` (bool): Also add the hosts to the allowlist.<br>• `pattern` (str): Regex the real value must match (checked by iron-proxy-set-secret). |

## Egress allowlist

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_allow_presets` | list of str | `[anthropic, openai_codex, github_read, npm, node, pypi, crates, golang, container_registries]` | Allowlist presets, see the Presets table at the end of docs/configuration.md. |
| `devbox_allow_rules_extra` | list of dict | `[]` | Additional iron-proxy allowlist rules.<br>Fields:<br>• `host` (str): Host glob, e.g. api.example.com or *.example.com.<br>• `cidr` (str): Destination network instead of a host.<br>• `methods` (list of str): Allowed methods (default: all).<br>• `paths` (list of str): Allowed paths, '/*' suffix for prefixes (default: all). |
| `devbox_github_write_repos` | list of str | `[]` | owner/repo the agent may push to and write through the REST API. GraphQL (used by gh) is bounded by the token's own permissions: limit the fine-grained PAT to the same repositories. |
| `devbox_git_ssh_aliases` | list of str | `[]` | SSH host aliases used in clones (git@alias:owner/repo) that the agent rewrites to HTTPS. |
| `devbox_upstream_deny_cidrs_extra` | list of str | `[]` | Networks iron-proxy must never dial, on top of the built-in list. |
| `devbox_upstream_allow_cidrs` | list of str | `[]` | Exceptions carved out of the deny list (e.g. one internal host). Loopback, link-local and metadata ranges are refused, as are networks broader than /8 (/32 for IPv6). |

## Network exceptions

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_agent_dns` | bool | `true` | Let the agent send DNS packets (UDP/TCP 53) to the host's resolvers. Needed by tools that resolve names themselves over the network (dig, some direct-egress clients). It does not control name lookups through the local resolver's socket (systemd-resolved, nscd), which keep working either way. DNS queries are not audited and can carry data out. |
| `devbox_agent_direct_egress` | list of dict | `[]` | Non-HTTP egress for the agent, bypassing iron-proxy. Keep it narrow.<br>Fields:<br>• `preset` (str (cloudflare_tunnel)): Use a predefined exception instead of the fields below.<br>• `name` (str): Label shown in the policy.<br>• `proto` (str (tcp \\| udp \\| both))<br>• `ports` (list of raw): Ports or ranges ("5000-5010").<br>• `cidrs` (list of str): Allowed destinations; omitted means any destination. |
| `devbox_proxy_direct_egress` | list of dict | `[]` | Ports other than 80/443 iron-proxy may reach (pair with an allow rule).<br>Fields:<br>• `cidrs` (list of str, required)<br>• `ports` (list of raw, required) |
| `devbox_agent_inbound_ports` | list of raw | `[]` | Ports (or ranges) on which the agent's own servers accept connections from outside the host (e.g. a P2P node). New inbound connections to any other agent-owned socket are refused in enforce mode, logged in observe mode; your provider firewall applies on top. |
| `devbox_agent_loopback_ports` | list of int | `[]` | Loopback TCP ports owned by other users that the agent may reach. |

## Agent environment and helpers

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_agent_clis` | list of str (claude \| codex \| hermes) | `[claude, codex]` | Agents installed for the agent user through the proxy (official installers / latest release, not pinned; they update themselves). See docs/agents.md. |
| `devbox_agent_env_extra` | dict | `{}` | Extra environment variables for the agent (names [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, values without spaces or quotes). |
| `devbox_agent_pkg_install` | bool | `true` | Install sudo agent-pkg-install (distribution packages from official repositories only). |
| `devbox_pkg_apt_sources` | str | `""` | deb822 sources used by agent-pkg-install on apt systems. Empty: the official Debian/Ubuntu archive for this release. |
| `devbox_pkg_dnf_repos` | list of str | computed | Repositories agent-pkg-install may use on dnf systems. |
| `devbox_agent_capture_ports` | list of raw | `[]` | Enable sudo agent-capture [seconds]: pcap of the agent's own traffic on these ports (nothing from other users). |

## Monitoring

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_monitoring_enabled` | bool | `true` | Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, Alloy and node_exporter on 127.0.0.1; disabling removes them. |
| `devbox_monitoring_retention` | str | `30d` | Metrics and logs retention (e.g. 30d). |
| `devbox_grafana_listen` | str | `127.0.0.1:3000` | Grafana address (host:port), loopback by default. |
| `devbox_monitoring_scrape_targets` | list of dict | `[]` | Extra Prometheus scrape targets (e.g. an app's /metrics). The agent can query every metric through its gateway.<br>Fields:<br>• `job` (str, required)<br>• `targets` (list of str, required)<br>• `path` (str): Metrics path (default /metrics). |
| `devbox_monitoring_journal_units_extra` | list of str | `[]` | Extra system units whose logs are shipped to Loki, without the ".service" suffix (e.g. nginx). The agent can read Loki through its gateway: only add units whose logs it may see. |

## Tailscale

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_tailscale_enabled` | bool | `false` | Install Tailscale and join the tailnet (admin side; the agent gets no tailnet access). |
| `devbox_tailscale_hostname` | str | computed | Machine name on the tailnet. |
| `devbox_tailscale_tags` | list of str | `[]` | Tags to advertise (must be allowed by your ACL tagOwners). |
| `devbox_tailscale_ssh` | bool | `false` | Enable Tailscale SSH on top of OpenSSH. |
| `devbox_tailscale_authkey_file` | path | `/etc/agent-devbox/tailscale-authkey` | One-shot auth key file on the server, consumed and deleted at join. |
| `devbox_tailscale_serve_grafana` | bool | `true` | Publish Grafana at https://<host>.<tailnet>.ts.net (tailnet only). |

## Local ports (loopback only; change only on conflict)

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devbox_proxy_tunnel_port` | int | `3128` | iron-proxy explicit proxy port (HTTPS_PROXY). |
| `devbox_proxy_https_port` | int | `18443` | iron-proxy transparent HTTPS port. |
| `devbox_proxy_http_port` | int | `18081` | iron-proxy transparent HTTP port. |
| `devbox_proxy_management_port` | int | `9092` | iron-proxy management API port. |
| `devbox_proxy_metrics_port` | int | `9464` | iron-proxy health port. |
| `devbox_obs_gateway_port` | int | `9095` | Read-only Prometheus/Loki gateway port for the agent. |

## iron-proxy (advanced)

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iron_proxy_version` | str | `0.54.0` | iron-proxy release to install (bump with iron_proxy_sha256). |
| `iron_proxy_sha256` | dict | `{amd64: 54d745b6c6e4a6d6cad1f58644df59487a87d5f037a8ddb7159c0a8e5d57dd4d, arm64: 867ebbb1a7ecd4ecdde978b6712dfb1321f20dbb0f49da39b6abd9a66a984473}` | sha256 of the release tarball per architecture (amd64, arm64). |
| `iron_proxy_log_level` | str (debug \| info \| warn \| error) | `info` | iron-proxy log level. |
| `iron_proxy_ca_days` | int | `730` | Lifetime of the MITM CA generated on first run (see docs/operations.md to rotate it). |

## Monitoring (advanced)

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `monitoring_releases` | dict | see defaults | Pinned releases: version, url template and sha256 per architecture for prometheus, node_exporter, loki, alloy and grafana. |
| `monitoring_ports` | dict | `{alloy: 12345, loki: 3100, loki_grpc: 9096, node_exporter: 9100, prometheus: 9090}` | Loopback ports of prometheus, node_exporter, loki, loki_grpc and alloy. |
